test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the word in this sentence that contains an error.

The report was submitted by the manager to friday evening.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary grammatical error in the sentence is the incorrect use of the preposition "**to**" before a time expression.
 
• When referring to a specific day or a part of a specific day (like Friday evening), the preposition "**on**" should be used.
 
• Alternatively, if the sentence implies a deadline, the preposition "**by**" could be used to mean "not later than."
 
• The phrase "to Friday" is typically only used to indicate a range (e.g., "from Monday to Friday").

Therefore, the correct answer is **to**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The report was submitted by the manager **on Friday** evening."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: report** – This is a singular countable noun acting as the subject of the passive sentence and is used correctly.
 
• **Option 2: submitted** – This is the past participle of the verb "submit," correctly forming the passive voice with "was."
 
• **Option 4: friday** – While this word contains a capitalization error (proper nouns like days of the week must start with a capital letter, i.e., **Friday**), the prepositional error "to" is the more significant functional grammatical mistake in this context.
 
• **Note:** In standard English, always capitalize the names of days (Monday, Tuesday, etc.) and months (January, February, etc.).
